what: Timeline center vertical line — a bright line (fill) grows from the top of the panel to the screen center, so its end always stays at the exact center. A diamond needle (tip) on that end rotates 2610° (a little over seven turns) from when the panel top crosses screen center until its bottom crosses it (tied to scroll, no curve)

duration.Dol: Panel top edge at screen center → bottom edge at screen center

options.at: Screen height where the line end rests (0~1), default .5
options.[data-fx-part=fill]: Light line that grows (child) — vertical strip whose top edge is attached to the top edge of the panel
options.[data-fx-part=tip]: (If present) needle that spins at the line end

use: …Timeline row…
note: In the original, up to the center of the first year cell the line first follows at the rate it enters the screen, then stays in the center — the part has no first cell and follows the center from the start

from.where: index.html .e-tl (needle timeline) — original timeline: fill height = Screen center − panel top edge (0~panel height), [data-timeline-tip] rotate 2610 ease none, trigger panel top center → bottom center scrub true
